name: Brew in Blizzard
source:
You were lucky to land a seasonal job at Cafe Calmagi, a mystical coffee shop with an air of wonder and magic within. Your stay is temporary, but maybe you could do something to create something everlasting, like maybe...form a bond beyond being a barista?

[From [url=https://ezleurnoe.itch.io/brew-in-blizzard]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你很幸运地在Cafe Calmagi找到了一份季节性工作，这是一家神秘的咖啡店，里面充满了奇迹和魔力。你的停留是暂时的，但也许你可以做一些事情来创造永恒的东西，比如也许……除了成为一名咖啡师之外，还可以建立一种联系？

[来自[url=https://ezleurnoe.itch.io/brew-in-blizzard]itch.io[/url]]
